purpose: Compare two things while giving added emphasis to the comparison.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Comparison noun / verb plain form + よりも
I would rather try it myself than hear about it.
formation: Comparison noun / verb plain form + よりも
restrictions: も strengthens the contrast; より alone often expresses the same basic comparison.
mistake: The phrase before よりも is the benchmark, not the more highly rated item.
